title: Rivetus: special object of justifying faith — Evangelical promise of Christ the Mediator
source_text: XXI. Sic docet Andr. Rivetus in Synopsi purioris Theologiae Professorum Leydensium, Quamvis, inquit, fides in sua latitudine sumpta, ut complectatur supernaturalem notitiam, assensum & fiduciam, quaecunque in Dei verbo tanquam ad salutem conducentia nobis sunt revelata, complectatur; est tamen quoddam fidei objectum speciale, quatenus est justificans. Postea vero explicat quodnam sit illud speciale fidei justificantis objectum: Fidei, inquit, quatenus est justificans, speciale objectum, & quod eam proprie a reliquis fidei acceptionibus discriminat, est promissio Evangelica de Christo mediatore. Eatenus enim proprie justificat & salvat, quatenus Christi meritum, in Verbo Evangelii sibi revelatum, apprehendit & amplectitur. Disputatione de Fide, Thesi 9, & 10.
pass_a_gloss: Thus teaches Andreas Rivetus in the Synopsis of purer Theology of the Leiden Professors: Although, he says, faith taken in its breadth, so that it embraces supernatural knowledge, assent and trust, embraces whatever things in God's word have been revealed to us as conducing to salvation; yet there is a certain special object of faith insofar as it is justifying. But afterward he explains what that special object of justifying faith is: Of faith, he says, insofar as it is justifying, the special object, and what properly discriminates it from the remaining acceptations of faith, is the Evangelical promise concerning Christ the Mediator. For so far it properly justifies and saves, insofar as it apprehends and embraces Christ's merit revealed to itself in the Word of the Gospel. Disputation on Faith, Thesis 9 and 10.
pass_b_english: Rivetus (Leiden Synopsis): faith in breadth embraces notitia, assent, fiducia toward all revealed unto salvation.
Yet as justifying it has a special object.
That object: the Evangelical promise of Christ the Mediator — what marks it off from other senses of faith.
It justifies/saves insofar as it apprehends and embraces Christ’s merit revealed in the Gospel word.
